fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on the approaching winter tourist season and rising rents in Greater Miami; disputes involving city inspection of utility meters and criticism of Florida Power & Light service; notes on school lunch conditions at Shenandoah School and concerns about public health (clinic treatment of venereal disease cases). Political and civic items include discussion of county and city officials, the Community Chest drive, and references to the Miami Chamber of Commerce information service. Also contains sports coverage (boxing and fronton events), society/press-box columns, letters to the editor, and extensive local advertising for Miami and Miami Beach businesses.
